2608.13341.title: Simulation-to-real transfer learning for infrared spectroscopic chemical sensing and analysis from molecules to complex samples
2608.13341.paper_summary: Infrared (IR) spectroscopy is widely used for chemical sensing, but extracting reliable chemical information from spectra remains challenging. Conventional interpretation is labor-intensive, relies on prior knowledge and reference spectra, and is difficult to scale, whereas most machine-learning methods are tailored to individual tasks or datasets, require large labeled training sets, and transfer poorly across analytical objectives and experimental datasets. Here we introduce UltraIR, a foundation model for IR spectroscopy with more than 100 million parameters that enables simulation-to-real transfer learning for chemical sensing and analysis from molecules to complex samples. UltraIR is pretrained on approximately 60 million simulated IR spectra using spectral reconstruction, molecular fingerprint similarity alignment, and functional-group prediction, then adapted to downstream objectives with task-specific labels or targets. Across functional-group prediction, molecular structure elucidation, physicochemical property prediction, mixture-component identification and quantification, bacterial classification, medicinal-herb geographic origin traceability and constituent quantification, microplastics classification, and soil property prediction, UltraIR outperforms conventional machine-learning and task-specific deep-learning baselines. It performs strongly with limited labeled experimental spectra and in zero-shot inference for the same analytical task across Fourier-transform infrared spectrometers and laboratories, providing a route to adaptable, data-efficient chemical sensing from complex real-world samples.
2608.13341.paper_summary_zh: 紅外線（IR）光譜學廣泛應用於化學感測，但從光譜中提取可靠的化學信息仍然具有挑戰性。傳統的解釋方法勞動密集，依賴於先前的知識和參考光譜，並且難以擴展，而大多數機器學習方法則是針對個別任務或數據集量身定制，需要大量標記的訓練集，並且在分析目標和實驗數據集之間轉移效果不佳。在此，我們介紹了UltraIR，一種擁有超過一億個參數的IR光譜學基礎模型，能夠實現從分子到複雜樣本的化學感測和分析的模擬到實際轉移學習。UltraIR在約6000萬個模擬IR光譜上進行預訓練，使用光譜重建、分子指紋相似性對齊和官能團預測，然後根據特定任務的標籤或目標進行下游調整。在官能團預測、分子結構闡明、物理化學性質預測、混合成分識別和定量、細菌分類、藥用植物地理來源可追溯性和成分定量、微塑料分類以及土壤性質預測等方面，UltraIR的表現超過了傳統的機器學習和特定任務的深度學習基準。它在有限的標記實驗光譜和零樣本推理中表現出色，能夠在相同的分析任務中跨越傅立葉變換紅外光譜儀和實驗室提供一條可適應的、數據高效的化學感測路徑，從複雜的現實世界樣本中獲取信息。
